title: LeanData public REST integration contract
scope: Reviewed option OI/discovery, financial archive endpoints and shared REST delivery/error metadata. Other product endpoints remain in their documentation; absence here is not an unavailable verdict.

authentication.credential: Opaque active LeanData token. Never log it or forward it to signed download delivery.

access_policies.options: An active plan with options access, with existing plan date/expiry restrictions. This contract does not grant entitlement.
access_policies.premium_financial: Premium financial-data authorization; availability and archive coverage remain separate.
access_policies.unavailable: No plan enables an unimplemented endpoint.

controls.direct: Only direct=1 opts into signed delivery; cache hits can still return 200.
controls.no_direct: no_direct=1 overrides direct and keeps same-origin bytes.

delivery.download_authentication: Signed URL only; use a separate request without Authorization, cookies or original body. Validate the exact HTTPS origin and never log the signed URL.
delivery.accounting: The initial API request counts once. Signed delivery adds no second public API request or delivery fee; API retries count again. Separately ordered bulk exports retain their pricing.

response_headers.X-Leandata-Contract: Contract version for the public metadata semantics.
response_headers.X-Leandata-Contract-SHA256: SHA256 of the exact UTF-8 contract JSON bytes.
response_headers.X-Leandata-Data-Tier: Logical serving tier, when known: hot-cache, archive, memory, source, snapshot-history. Not a freshness or coverage guarantee.
response_headers.X-Cache-Tier: Legacy compatibility field retained during migration. New integrations should prefer X-Leandata-Data-Tier; no removal date is scheduled.

errors.action: Correct parameters; do not retry an unchanged request.
Correct or renew credentials before retrying.
Check plan and endpoint entitlement; an upgrade cannot implement a 501 endpoint.
Read the error code to distinguish account rate/concurrency from shared capacity. Honor Retry-After when supplied, otherwise use bounded exponential backoff with jitter.
Endpoint unavailable; do not retry or upgrade solely for this response.
Service or source temporarily unavailable; use bounded retries.

compatibility: Existing supported paths and payload schemas remain intact. Replacement URLs are guidance, not automatic redirects or claims of identical schemas.

operations.summary: Historical quote at a time; bounded whole-chain queries are supported.
operations.notes: The exact-contract restriction of latest OI is not a blanket wildcard ban on quote history.

operations.summary: Upcoming earnings, dividends and splits; latest committed capture per snapshot date by default.

parameters.name: dataset
parameters.description: earnings (default), dividends or splits. One dataset per request.

parameters.name: bundle
parameters.description: Optional exact 64-character SHA256 from coverage. Pin it for stable pagination and preserve source revisions.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Inclusive snapshot date; defaults to end minus 6 days without symbols, or 30 days with symbols. This is not the event date.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Inclusive snapshot_date upper bound, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to current UTC date.

parameters.name: symbols
parameters.description: Up to 100 comma-separated captured ticker symbols. Without symbols, at most 7 inclusive calendar days are permitted.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Positive integer, capped at 500 (default 500).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: 0..100000; later pages require the response snapshot token or an exact bundle.

parameters.name: versions
parameters.description: latest (default) selects the newest committed batch for each capture date, including empty batches; all returns all preserved versions.

parameters.name: snapshot
parameters.description: Opaque response selection token. Reuse it with the same filters for stable pagination while new batches arrive.

operations.clocks: start/end select snapshot_date. Event dates (report_date, dividend_date, payment_date or split date) are separate native payload fields. Capture time is not a verified vendor publication timestamp.
operations.response_schema: qc_native_history_v1: source=eodhd, dataset, count, data, truncated, next_offset, research_admission=false. Each data row contains bundle, row_id, source_sha256 and original payload. Numeric JSON bytes and null values are retained.
operations.notes: Capture-date filters, not event-date filters. Latest selection does not infer upstream completeness. Pin snapshot for subsequent pages; bundle keeps exact raw capture semantics. GET/POST and optional signed delivery share the same selectors. Financial values use Morningstar daily/history. Expected daily refresh starts 06:00 America/Los_Angeles; coverage reports actual available captures.
operations.example_note: Illustrative snapshot date. Inspect coverage first and use a captured date and bundle.

operations.summary: Committed EODHD capture coverage and source provenance, including empty captured datasets.

parameters.name: dataset
parameters.description: earnings (default), dividends or splits. One dataset per request.

parameters.name: bundle
parameters.description: Optional exact 64-character SHA256 from coverage. Pin it for stable pagination and preserve source revisions.

operations.response_schema: qc_native_coverage_v1: data rows contain bundle, family, dataset, rows, first_date, last_date, source_sha256 and metadata (run, source_csv, source_csv_sha256, upstream_completeness_verified=false). Date bounds describe observed snapshots; empty datasets can have null bounds. daily_coverage separates latest_capture_date from latest_nonempty_date and reports selected batch, row count and captured-empty state per day for the latest 31-day capture window. Reader failure returns 503 rather than omitting selected-capture freshness.
operations.notes: Future earnings dates are provided through daily event snapshots; financial statement data is updated through Morningstar routes. Read the latest available snapshot and filter payload.report_date for upcoming earnings. Event dates may change in subsequent snapshots. Empty data does not prove no events. research_admission remains false. Default delivery is same-origin; direct=1 optionally uses the shared signed GET delivery contract. Cache-only/upstream-only controls are unsupported. Coverage applies only dataset and optional bundle; history dates, symbols, limit, offset and fields do not filter it. Coverage count is dataset manifest count, not event row count. No pagination is applied. EODHD and Morningstar updates are expected to start daily at 06:00 America/Los_Angeles (PST/PDT); actual published snapshots are reported by the matching coverage endpoint.

operations.summary: One daily financial history query over the historical archive and recent captures, with source-labelled rows and preserved gaps.

parameters.name: symbols
parameters.description: Up to 100 observed ticker aliases. Identity is QC SID; ambiguous aliases require sids.

parameters.name: sids
parameters.description: Up to 100 exact comma-separated QC SIDs. Symbols and SIDs select their union.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Subset of the 64 canonical v3 field names. Default: all. Values are always a JSON object with numbers or null.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Inclusive source daily date; default end minus 6 days without identity filters, otherwise minus 30 days.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Inclusive source daily date, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to current UTC date.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Positive integer, capped at 500.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: 0..100000. Subsequent pages require snapshot.

parameters.name: snapshot
parameters.description: Opaque, authenticated selection token returned by the first page; fixes source store and immutable capture set. Keep filters unchanged. Narrow the window if more than 128 source bundles are needed.

operations.response_schema: morningstar_daily_history_v1: rows(date,qc_sid,symbol,values,status,source,source_dates), row_count, truncated, next_offset, snapshot, unresolved_symbols, research_admission=false.
operations.notes: One row per SID/date; newest committed native row takes precedence as a whole, with no field filling from another feed. Legacy admission codes/file dates and native source dates remain explicit. No gap filling or strict PIT certification. Unfiltered history spans at most seven inclusive calendar days. Existing v3 and native raw routes keep their separate source contracts. Reader failure returns 503 rather than silently falling back to all revisions.

operations.summary: Coverage for a requested daily window, with separate sources, unobserved weekdays and latest-day field missingness.

parameters.name: symbols
parameters.description: Up to 100 observed ticker aliases. Identity is QC SID; ambiguous aliases require sids.

parameters.name: sids
parameters.description: Up to 100 exact comma-separated QC SIDs. Symbols and SIDs select their union.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Subset of the 64 canonical v3 field names. Default: all. Values are always a JSON object with numbers or null.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Inclusive source daily date; default end minus 6 days without identity filters, otherwise minus 30 days.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Inclusive source daily date, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to current UTC date.

parameters.name: snapshot
parameters.description: Opaque, authenticated selection token returned by the first page; fixes source store and immutable capture set. Keep filters unchanged. Narrow the window if more than 128 source bundles are needed.

operations.response_schema: morningstar_daily_coverage_v1: source by_date counts, observed_dates, unobserved_weekdays, latest_native_day.missing_by_field, unresolved_symbols, snapshot, expected_symbols=null, stock_coverage_ratio=null, research_admission=false.
operations.notes: Coverage uses requested dates/identities and allows at most 366 elapsed days. Weekday gaps may include market holidays. Observed stocks are not a verified expected-universe denominator; missing values remain null. It does not certify upstream completeness or a 06:00 completion SLA.

eodhd_events.time_semantics: Expected collection/update start, not a guaranteed completion time. Pacific time follows PST/PDT daylight-saving changes. Inspect coverage for the latest published snapshot.
eodhd_events.data_semantics: Upcoming earnings report dates in payload.report_date; financial statement values are provided through Morningstar routes.

morningstar_financials.time_semantics: Expected collection/update start, not a guaranteed completion time. Pacific time follows PST/PDT daylight-saving changes. Inspect the matching route coverage for the latest published snapshot.
morningstar_financials.data_semantics: Financial statement and fundamental values from available company reports; separate from the EODHD upcoming earnings schedule. Frozen legacy routes retain their documented archive boundary.
